name: AI Recipe: Audio Podcast
description: Renders the oldest unrendered podcast script to an episode: Claude casts a preset voice per speaker and writes show notes, then every line is spoken with Gemini or ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Exits cleanly when there's nothing to render.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Speech engine
parameters.help: auto uses GEMINI_API_KEY if set, else ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. Preset voices only.

author: ai-automation-tools
